resposta: The dawn breaks not as fire but as a grey sheet draped over the head of the house, hiding the father who watches the void with a vision of pebbles in his pockets, *yet* he hears the footsteps of the living walking upon the skin of the world. You possess the hands of a potter to mold the clay of the evening, *so* you can fashion a hearth where the smoke rises sweet and cheap, covering the poverty that creeps under the door like a snake seeking warmth. But if you turn your face away, towards the horizon of the road where the carriages rumble, you leave him to the hunger, *and* to the silence of the cupboard which opens and shuts without sound, though the hunger rings in the throat of the hungry. Is the choice a sword drawn to slay, or a shield to protect? Or is the truth simply the fact that all roads end in the same garden? To go is to return to the beginning, where the seed drops into the earth, and the soil swallows the root, knowing that the tree shall rise again from the dust of the dead and the alive, breathing in the mist of the river, *for* even the blind father knows the name of the moon when the night comes and goes around the corner.
